# 1 Clement Chapter 7 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic Equivalence)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 7 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_007_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 7

**7:1** Dear friends, we are writing all this not just to correct you, but to remind ourselves as well — because we are in the same arena, and the same contest faces all of us.

**7:2** So let us put aside all empty, futile thinking, and come back to the glorious and holy standard of our heritage.

**7:3** Let us fix our attention on what is good and pleasing and acceptable to the God who made us.

**7:4** Let us look steadily at the blood of Christ and understand how precious it is to his Father — shed for our salvation, it brought the grace of repentance to the whole world.

**7:5** Let us go through every generation in history and see that in each generation the Lord has offered the opportunity to repent to all who wanted to turn to him.

**7:6** Noah preached repentance, and those who listened were rescued. [Gen 6-8]

**7:7** Jonah announced destruction to the Ninevites; they turned from their sins, cried out to God for mercy, and were saved — even though they were outsiders, with no prior claim on God. [Jon 3]

---
